items.raw_excerpt: Infraestruturas de Portugal, Lusoponte and Fertagus will promote a 3D drone show over the Tagus River, in the early morning of 6 August, the day that marks the 60th anniversary of the inauguration of the 25th of April Bridge.
items.summary_en: A 3D drone show will light up the sky above the Tagus River early on 6 August. It celebrates the 60th anniversary of the opening of the 25th of April Bridge.

items.title_en: 25th of April Bridge turns 60 with a drone show
items.title_ko: 4월 25일 다리 60주년, 테주 강 위에서 드론 쇼
items.title_original: 25th of April Bridge marks 60 years with drone show

items.raw_excerpt: Every year, parents of school-age children in France are sent a lengthy and complicated list of stationery that they must purchase - Helen Massy-Beresford offers parental tips on navigating the technicalities while also saving money.
items.summary_en: Every year, parents of school-age children in France get a long and complicated list of stationery to buy. One parent shares tips on how to read the list and save money.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에서는 매년 학부모에게 길고 복잡한 학용품 구매 목록이 전달됩니다. 한 부모가 목록을 읽는 요령과 비용을 아끼는 팁을 공개했습니다.
items.title_en: The dreaded French school stationery lists
items.title_original: Fournitures scolaires: The dreaded French school stationery lists

items.raw_excerpt: The first chapter of the “Harry Potter” film saga is returning to Portuguese cinemas from 27 to 30 August, as part of the celebrations marking the film’s 25th anniversary.
items.summary_en: The first Harry Potter movie returns to Portuguese cinemas from August 27 to 30. The special showings celebrate the film's 25th anniversary.

items.raw_excerpt: South Goa will witness a widespread power outage on Sunday, April 12, due to the annual maintenance shutdown of 220KV and 110KV substations... Read more on Prudent Media Goa.
items.summary_en: South Goa will have a power outage on Sunday, April 12. It happens because of annual maintenance of the substations. Residents should get ready for the disruption.

items.title_en: South Goa to face power shutdown on Sunday

items.raw_excerpt: VHO - Trong hai ngày 15 và 16.7, Hiệp hội Du lịch TP. Huế phối hợp với Viện Nghiên cứu Nam Á, Tây Á và Châu Phi (Viện Hàn lâm Khoa học xã hội Việt Nam) tổ chức tọa đàm và tập huấn “Nghiên cứu, phát triển du lịch Halal trên địa bàn TP. Huế”.
items.summary_en: Hue's tourism association held a seminar on developing Halal tourism in the city on July 15-16. It was organized with Vietnamese research institutes. The event included talks and training for local tourism workers.
items.summary_ko: 후에시 관광협회가 7월 15~16일 할랄 관광 개발을 위한 세미나를 열었습니다. 베트남 연구 기관들과 함께 행사를 준비했습니다. 지역 관광 관계자들을 위한 강연과 교육이 진행됐습니다.
items.title_en: Hue holds seminar to boost Halal tourism

items.title_original: Huế nâng cao năng lực phát triển du lịch Halal - Vietnam.vn

items.raw_excerpt: If you're driving around France this summer and pass through different communes, you might encounter some extremely long names, although they cannot top this 38-letter monster.
items.summary_en: The longest place name in France has 38 letters. It belongs to a small village in eastern France. The name is so long that it is hard to say in one breath.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에서 가장 긴 지명은 모두 38자나 됩니다. 그 지명은 프랑스 동부의 작은 마을에 있습니다. 이름이 너무 길어 한 번에 말하기 어렵습니다.
items.title_en: France's longest place name has 38 letters
items.title_original: Revealed: The longest place name in France

items.raw_excerpt: Many places in the country will be waking up to freezing weather on Thursday, with MetService warning of double-digit negative temperatures in parts of the south.
items.summary_en: Many places in New Zealand will wake up to freezing weather on Thursday. The weather service warns of very low temperatures, below minus 10 degrees, in parts of the south. People should prepare for a very cold start to the day.
items.summary_ko: 목요일 뉴질랜드 여러 곳이 영하의 추운 날씨로 아침을 맞을 예정입니다. 기상청은 남부 일부 지역에서 영하 10도 이하의 기온이 예상된다고 경고했습니다. 추운 아침을 미리 대비해야 합니다.
items.title_en: Another freezing morning across New Zealand
items.title_ko: 또 다시 찾아온 서리 내린 아침, 남부 영하 10도 이하 경고
items.title_original: Another frosty start as MetService warns of negative temperatures

items.raw_excerpt: A 73-year-old retired nurse's decision to learn to write Tibetan language offers a glimpse into how some embrace their language and cultural identity in Tibet.
items.summary_en: A 73-year-old retired nurse decided to learn to write the Tibetan language. Her story shows how some Tibetans keep their language and cultural identity alive. They work to preserve their culture under China's new 'unity' law.
items.summary_ko: 73세 은퇴 간호사가 티베트어 쓰기를 배우기 시작했다. 그녀의 이야기는 일부 티베트인들이 언어와 문화적 정체성을 지키는 방식을 보여 준다. 중국의 새 통일법 아래에서 문화를 보존하려는 노력이다.
items.title_en: Retired nurse, 73, learns to write Tibetan language
items.title_ko: 73세 은퇴 간호사, 티베트어 쓰기 배우기 시작해
items.title_original: Under China's new 'unity' law, Tibetans fight to preserve language and culture

items.raw_excerpt: Jacobs uses DNA extracted from animal dung to identify individual animals.
items.summary_en: Researchers in South Africa found a new way to watch wild animals. They take DNA from animal dung to tell each animal apart. This helps count and protect wildlife without touching the animals.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 연구진이 야생 동물을 지켜보는 새로운 방법을 찾았습니다. 동물의 똥에서 DNA를 추출해 동물마다 구별합니다. 동물을 만지지 않고도 야생 동물을 세고 보호하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
items.title_en: Scientists use animal dung DNA to watch wildlife
items.title_ko: 동물 똥 DNA로 야생 동물을 지켜보는 새 방법
items.title_original: UFS researchers develop DNA-based wildlife monitoring technique

items.raw_excerpt: Kochi accelerates canal restoration to combat waterlogging, with intensified inspections and urgent drain cleaning measures.
items.summary_en: Kochi is speeding up canal restoration to prevent waterlogging. Officials are doing more inspections and cleaning drains urgently. The work aims to keep the city dry during heavy rain.
items.summary_ko: 코치 시가 침수를 막기 위해 배수로 복원 작업을 서두르고 있습니다. 관계자들은 점검을 강화하고 배수구 청소를 긴급히 진행하고 있습니다. 이 작업은 비가 많이 올 때 도심을 건조하게 유지하기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: Kochi speeds up canal restoration to stop waterlogging
items.title_ko: 코치 시, 배수로 복원을 서둘러 물난리 예방
items.title_original: Canal restoration to be expedited to curb waterlogging in Kochi

items.raw_excerpt: Portugal is on track for a stronger wine harvest this year, with production expected to increase by around 12% compared to 2025.
items.summary_en: Portugal will likely have a better wine harvest this year. Production may rise by about 12 percent compared to 2025.

items.title_en: Portugal expects 12 percent more wine this harvest
